entries.value: 一顆像來自深處的水晶般發光的燦爛紫色寶石。

entries.value: 一篇精采的論文，記錄了各種青蛙的外貌、牠們對周遭野生動物的影響，以及……超乎我們想像的現實裂縫？什麼？

entries.value: 一朵只在獨處時綻放的嬌嫩花朵，在屬於自己的寧靜空間裡茁壯成長。

entries.value: 一顆美味、鮮豔又圓滾滾的糖果，還帶著一點刺激。

entries.key: A delightful treat from the Factory. Its crisp taste sparks joy with every bite.
entries.value: 來自工廠的可口點心。爽脆的口感讓每一口都充滿喜悅。

entries.key: A dense testament to time, holding the chronicles of ancient figs.
entries.value: 時間的厚重見證，記載著遠古無花果的編年史。

entries.key: A disgusting ball of mushed shark matter.
entries.value: 一團噁心的鯊魚肉泥球。

entries.key: A distant relative of the {mob}, it's always scheming.
entries.value: {mob}的遠親，總是在打著壞主意。

entries.value: 一顆絕美的萊姆色寶石。讓你想起一片草地。

entries.value: 一位著名的{npc}曾用這些做成的法杖。

entries.value: 一位傳奇農夫，據說是受太陽恩典而生。他徒手耕作大地，並用收成烘烤樸實的麵包碗，只送給他心中最親近的人。

entries.key: A flower so soft and creamy, it could almost pass for milk. Just don't be tempted to try drinking it.
entries.value: 一朵柔軟又滑順的花，幾乎可以假裝成牛奶。只是千萬別想喝它。

entries.key: A forceful Gold Axe which can break a large amount of logs in a single hit! Only available for Stranded players.
entries.value: 一把強力的金斧，一擊就能砍斷大量原木！僅限 Stranded 玩家使用。

entries.key: A fragment of the core of {pet}.

entries.key: A fusion of vine resilience and sap vitality.

entries.value: 一朵像將熄餘燼般發光的朦朧花朵，困在火焰與生命之間。

entries.value: 一顆又大又美味的莓果。吃下它的小動物短時間內都不會餓。

entries.value: 一片長在地上的葉子。真是突破極限。

entries.value: 外表有點粗糙，但內在自有其美。

entries.value: 一塊捕捉了冬季慶典溫暖與歡樂的魔法碎片。

entries.value: 一株把水全部喝光、再像水球一樣膨脹的植物。

entries.key: A plant that hardens into a shining green gemstone as it matures, ready to be mined.
entries.value: 一株成熟時會硬化成閃亮綠色寶石的植物，可以開採。

entries.key: A plant that only thrives in the presence of decay, its petals growing strong where life once was. Only death thrives the living.
entries.value: 一株只在腐朽中茁壯的植物，花瓣在曾有生命之處盛開。唯有死亡能滋養生者。

entries.key: A plate forged from an assortment of the most durable materials found in this world.
entries.value: 用這個世界上最耐用的各種材料鍛造的板甲。

entries.key: A portion of {mob}'s Soul that can be used to craft items.
entries.value: {mob}靈魂的一部分，可用來合成物品。

entries.key: A powerful artifact ingrained with protective properties.
entries.value: 一件蘊含守護之力的強大神器。

entries.key: A powerful blade forged in the depths of the {area}.
entries.value: 一把在{area}深處鍛造的強大刀刃。

entries.key: A powerful charge, capable of damaging {pet}'s tentacles!
entries.value: §7一股強大的電荷，能夠傷害{pet}§c的§7觸手！

entries.key: A powerful tool that breaks after {0} uses.
entries.value: 一件使用 {0} 次後會損壞的強大工具。

entries.key: A powerful tool that doesn't seem to break.
entries.value: 一件似乎不會損壞的強大工具。

entries.key: A precious trinket from a powerful member of The Family who doesn't really need it anymore....
entries.value: 一件來自家族中某位大人物的珍貴小飾品，他其實已經不太需要了……

entries.key: A private joke amongst Wizards, but you wouldn't understand.
entries.value: 巫師之間的私房笑話，你不會懂的。

entries.key: A quaint box holding a trove of whimsy and woe: from {pet}'s cherished childhood memories to his most profound mysteries.
entries.value: 一個古雅的盒子，裝滿了奇思妙想與憂愁：從{pet}珍貴的童年回憶，到他最深奧的謎團。

entries.key: A quest NPC that sells the {item} and the {item2}
entries.value: 販售{item}與{item2}的任務 NPC

entries.key: A rare space helmet forged from shards of moon glass.
entries.value: 一頂用月光玻璃碎片打造的稀有太空頭盔。

entries.key: A razor-sharp shark fin designed to craft powerful items.
entries.value: 一片鋒利無比的鯊魚鰭，用來合成強大的物品。

entries.key: A recreation of a medal {npc} used to give out for his contests. They are too popular now to be given out.
entries.value: {npc}過去在競賽中頒發的獎牌複製品。現在太受歡迎，已經不再頒發了。

entries.key: A recreation of the coating found on {npc}'s tools from his greatest expeditions.
entries.value: 仿製{npc}在他最偉大的探險中所用工具上的塗層。

entries.key: A refined form of heavy rock from the darkest depths.
entries.value: 來自最黑暗深處的沉重岩石的精煉形態。

entries.key: A relentless plant that spreads its root far and wide, consuming and destroying everything in its path.
entries.value: 一株頑強的植物，根系蔓延四方，吞噬並摧毀路徑上的一切。

entries.key: A remnant of the core of {pet}!
entries.value: {pet}核心的殘骸！

entries.key: A research on how to preserve and enhance class abilities in death.
entries.value: 一份關於如何在死亡中保存並強化職業技能的研究。

entries.key: A ring that calls you towards the eternal flame of the pits of lava.
entries.value: 一枚呼喚你前往岩漿坑永恆火焰的戒指。

entries.key: A rose with thick vines and thorns sharper than they should be.
entries.value: 一朵藤蔓粗壯、尖刺異常銳利的玫瑰。

entries.key: A rusted hilt, dropped by the {mob}.
entries.value: 一個生鏽的劍柄，由{mob}掉落。

entries.key: A savory snack given to those who skillfully entertain and impress with their tricks!
entries.value: 一份美味的點心，送給以把戲巧妙娛樂、驚豔眾人的人！

entries.key: A scroll ingrained with an ancient symbol.
entries.value: 一張刻有古老符號的卷軸。

entries.key: A seed full of promise, but it thirsts for an odd, egg-shaped gift to awaken.
entries.value: 一顆充滿希望的種子，但它渴望一份奇特的蛋形禮物才能甦醒。

entries.key: A seed so powerful, it feels like it shouldn't exist. Its growth knows no limits.
entries.value: 一顆強大到彷彿不該存在的種子。它的成長沒有極限。

entries.key: A series of NPCs located in the trees of the {area} in the {island}.
entries.value: 位於{island}{area}樹上的一系列 NPC。

entries.key: A series of tales following a fellow named {npc} and his waterfowl best friend. Who would be so egregious as to thrust such a literary masterpiece into the sea?
entries.value: 一系列關於一位名叫{npc}的人和他最好的水鳥朋友的故事。是誰這麼過分，竟把這樣的文學傑作丟進海裡？

entries.key: A set of NPCs that sell the Wyld Armor set.
entries.value: §7販售§a荒野盔甲§7套裝的一組 NPC。

entries.key: A set of beautiful antlers adorn your head. Obtained from the {npc} {0} {month} Bundle.
entries.value: 一對美麗的鹿角裝飾你的頭頂。從{npc} {0} {month}組合包中獲得。

entries.key: A shard of a Dungeon {enchantment}, capable of being bestowed upon another player for a continuous buff, but draining mana.
entries.value: 一塊地下城{enchantment}的碎片，可以賦予另一名玩家持續增益，但會消耗魔力。

entries.key: A sharp rock with sturdy construction.
entries.value: 一塊結構堅固的尖銳石頭。

entries.key: A shell of their former self.
entries.value: 昔日風采不再，只剩空殼。

entries.key: A shiny orange gem that glows faintly.
entries.value: 一顆微微發光的亮橘色寶石。

entries.key: A short walk for you is a long walk for them.
entries.value: 對你來說的一小段路，對牠們來說是很長的一段路。

entries.key: A shy little fellow!
entries.value: 一個害羞的小傢伙！

entries.key: A single, all-seeing eye, forcefully removed from the {mob} Broodfather. Though expressionless, you can sense the rage that permeates throughout.
entries.value: 一隻從{mob}巢母身上強行挖下的全視之眼。雖然面無表情，你仍能感受到其中瀰漫的怒火。

entries.key: A single-page printout outlining why the candidate's application should be accepted. Why are these a thing? Just read the application itself...
entries.value: 一頁列印文件，說明為什麼應該接受該候選人的申請。這種東西為什麼存在？直接讀申請書就好了啊……

entries.key: A slightly better version of Amber, but it could still use some work.
entries.value: §7稍微好一點的§6琥珀§7，但還有改進空間。

entries.key: A small bag containing a large amount of birdseed.
entries.value: 一個裝滿大量鳥飼料的小袋子。

entries.key: A small but sharp claw once used for digging tunnels.
entries.value: 一隻小而鋒利的爪子，曾經用來挖隧道。

entries.key: A small coin depicting a wrinkly, bearded frog. Coins of this nature are said to bring good luck when thrown into small fountains or ponds.
entries.value: 一枚刻著滿臉皺紋、留著鬍子的青蛙的小硬幣。據說把這種硬幣丟進小噴泉或池塘能帶來好運。

entries.key: A small piece of a giant glacier. Doesn't ever melt.
entries.value: 巨大冰河的一小塊。永遠不會融化。

entries.key: A small piece of a prism. Obtained from {item} Sales.
entries.value: 稜鏡的一小塊碎片。從{item}特賣中獲得。

entries.key: A small piece of nature. Obtained from the {npc} {month} Bundle.
entries.value: 一小片大自然。從{npc}{month}組合包中獲得。

entries.key: A small piece of royalty. Obtained from {item} Sales.
entries.value: 一小片皇室風範。從{item}特賣中獲得。

entries.key: A smell so aromatic that even rodents can't resist.
entries.value: 香得連齧齒動物都無法抗拒。

entries.key: A smoldering root that oddly can also be used as fuel.
entries.value: 一根悶燒的樹根，奇怪的是也能當作燃料。

entries.key: A soggy journal that you retrieved from the {area}.
entries.value: 你從{area}撈回的一本濕透的日誌。

entries.key: A soul a day keeps the doctor away.
entries.value: 一天一個靈魂，醫生遠離我。

entries.key: A soul torn from its host and obliterated by a vacuum fan.
entries.value: 一個被從宿主身上撕下、再被吸蟲器風扇粉碎的靈魂。

entries.key: A special seed from {pet} himself! However it's missing something...
entries.value: 一顆來自{pet}本人的特殊種子！不過好像少了點什麼……

entries.key: A splendid handle belonging to a feared foe. In exchange for granting them immense power, it saps the life force from its wielder.
entries.value: 一個屬於可怕敵人的精美握柄。它賦予持有者強大的力量，代價是吸取他們的生命力。

entries.key: A splendid jewel, once thrown into the {collections_res} Eater's pond as tribute. It now serves as the centerpiece of the {mob}'s makeshift crown.
entries.value: 一顆精美的寶石，曾被當作貢品丟進{collections_res}食者的池塘。現在成了{mob}臨時王冠的核心裝飾。

entries.key: A splendid shard that was buried in the earth by someone a long, long time ago.
entries.value: 一塊很久很久以前被某人埋在地下的精美碎片。

entries.key: A splendid wool found nowhere else; it caresses your fingers and exudes a unique warmth the likes of which you have never experienced before, and likely never will again.
entries.value: 一種別處找不到的精美羊毛；它輕撫你的指尖，散發出你從未體驗過、也許再也不會體驗到的獨特溫暖。

entries.key: A splendid, yet tiny crown; just about the right size for your pet!
entries.value: 一頂精美又迷你的王冠，大小剛好適合你的寵物！

entries.key: A squishy moist mess.
entries.value: 一團軟爛潮濕的東西。

entries.key: A squishy trail to follow your arrows!
entries.value: 一道跟著你箭矢的軟綿綿軌跡！

entries.key: A step beyond zealotry.
entries.value: 比狂熱更進一步。

entries.key: A stick of a sweet-smelling incense. It makes you feel at ease.
entries.value: 一支散發甜香的線香。讓你感到放鬆。

entries.key: A strange bean that starts growing in unexpected ways, stretching higher and higher.
entries.value: 一顆奇怪的豆子，以意想不到的方式開始生長，越長越高。

entries.key: A suspiciously heavy gift given to you by Chuckleton.
entries.value: §c Chuckleton §7送你的一份重得可疑的禮物。

entries.key: A tail ending in a thick club that was used to fend off predators.
entries.value: 一條末端是粗大棍狀物的尾巴，用來抵禦掠食者。

entries.key: A terrifying sphere of extreme spookiness.
entries.value: 一顆極度驚悚的恐怖球體。

entries.key: A test subject to see if a sheep shrinks when it dries.
entries.value: 一個用來測試綿羊乾了會不會縮水的實驗對象。

entries.key: A thank you present from a grateful person in the {island}.
entries.value: {island}一位心懷感激的人送的謝禮。

entries.key: A ticking time bomb to new life. Acquired using {item}.
entries.value: 一顆即將迎來新生命的定時炸彈。使用{item}取得。

entries.key: A torn article of men's clothing, waterlogged and mossy. Probably too late to ask for a refund.
entries.value: 一件破損的男裝，泡過水又長滿青苔。現在要求退款大概太晚了。

entries.key: A toy brought to life.
entries.value: 一個活過來的玩具。

entries.key: A truly magnificent egg is nestled within - that much you can tell by weight alone.
entries.value: 裡面藏著一顆真正非凡的蛋——光是重量就能感覺得出來。

entries.key: A truly remarkable pencil. Refined, sharpened, and polished over time.
entries.value: 一支真正非凡的鉛筆。經過長時間的修整、削尖與打磨。

entries.key: A twisted version of the Venus flytrap, this plant thrives on feeding its insatiable hunger for flesh. It requires regular offerings to stay alive, or it withers away.
entries.value: 捕蠅草的扭曲版本，這株植物以滿足對血肉永不饜足的渴望為生。它需要定期供奉才能存活，否則就會枯萎。

entries.value: §7一種顯然經過細心處理的§6琥珀§7。

entries.key: A type of silk woven by the {mob}. It's so soft that it practically trickles through your fingers as you hold it.
entries.value: 一種由{mob}編織的絲。柔軟到拿在手上時幾乎會從指縫間流走。

entries.key: A very careful and aware wolf.
entries.value: 一隻非常謹慎又警覺的狼。

entries.key: A very shy.. thing...
entries.value: 一個非常害羞的……東西……

entries.key: A vial of particularly clear water, gathered from Torrhus {month} by {npc} herself. It exudes a faint warmth when pressed against your chest, reminding you of fond memories of days gone by.
entries.value: 一小瓶特別清澈的水，由{npc}親自從托赫斯{month}取得。貼在胸口時會散發淡淡的暖意，讓你想起過往的美好回憶。

entries.key: A waning shard of sunlight, as though torn from a forgotten age.
entries.value: 一道逐漸消逝的陽光碎片，彷彿是從被遺忘的時代撕下來的。

entries.key: A well-preserved fossil featuring a coiled shell.
entries.value: 一塊保存良好、帶有螺旋殼的化石。

entries.key: A well-preserved set of neural spines. Whatever possessed these was an adept swimmer.
entries.value: 一組保存良好的神經棘。擁有它的生物想必是個游泳高手。

entries.key: A well-wrapped present that's hot to the touch.
entries.value: 一份包裝得很好、摸起來很燙的禮物。

entries.key: A well-written paper, complete with labeled diagrams. It explores frog biodiversity and details key efforts made in the name of conservation.
entries.value: 一篇寫得很好的論文，附有標註完整的圖表。探討了青蛙的生物多樣性，並詳述以保育為名的重要行動。

entries.key: A withering husk of its former self.
entries.value: 昔日風采不再，只剩枯萎的空殼。

entries.key: A wonderful circle of flowers consumes you! Obtained from the {npc} {month} Bundle.
entries.value: 一圈美妙的花朵將你包圍！從{npc}{month}組合包中獲得。

entries.key: A wonderful enchanted plant!
entries.value: 一株美妙的附魔植物！

entries.key: A wonderful plant!
entries.value: 一株美妙的植物！

entries.key: A wooden barrel, stuffed to the brim with riches of all sorts. The lid won't even fit on it!
entries.value: 一個木桶，裡面塞滿了各式財寶，連蓋子都蓋不上！

entries.key: A {mob} forms from the depths.
entries.value: 一隻{mob}從深處成形。

entries.key: A {pet} {pet2} is attached to this bone. {pet3} Spirits always come back to their masters.
entries.value: 一隻{pet}{pet2}依附在這根骨頭上。{pet3}之靈總會回到主人身邊。

entries.key: ALL monsters have double {stats}!
entries.value: 所有怪物的{stats}都加倍！

entries.key: Abilities have {0}/{1} of the mana cost.
entries.value: 技能的魔力消耗變為 {0}/{1}。

entries.key: Absorption {roman} ({0}:{1}) Grants {2} of absorption.
Accessories have never tasted so sweet.
entries.value: 飾品從來沒有這麼甜過。

entries.key: Accessory Size {roman} Grants {0} extra Accessory Bag slots.
entries.value: §6飾品容量 {roman} §7額外獲得 {0} §7個§a飾品袋§7欄位。

entries.key: According to rumors, Shen himself has been crafting special items for sale to SkyBlock's richest players.
entries.value: 傳聞 Shen 本人一直在製作特殊物品，賣給 SkyBlock 最富有的玩家。

entries.key: According to {boss} Selta they are {0}V batteries and can supply about {1}mA of current. {boss2} Selta is currently in a mental asylum.
entries.value: 根據{boss} Selta 的說法，它們是 {0}V 電池，能提供約 {1}mA 的電流。{boss2} Selta 目前住在精神病院。

entries.key: Activate Glyphs to imbue them with a Warding Spell.
entries.value: §7啟動§5符文§7來為其注入§9防護法術§7。

entries.key: Activates all perks of another mayor every {0} Skyblock Days ({1} hours).
entries.value: 每 {0} 個 SkyBlock 日（{1} 小時）啟動另一位市長的所有天賦。

entries.key: Add some flair to your island with custom floating text!
entries.value: 用自訂浮空文字為你的島嶼增添風采！

entries.key: Added to Resistance potions.
entries.value: 加入抗性藥水中。

entries.key: Adds particles matching your + color to your pet and yourself, defaulting to red. Editable in Hypixel lobbies.
entries.value: §7為你的寵物和你自己加上與你§f + §7號顏色相符的粒子，預設為紅色。§8可在 Hypixel 大廳中編輯。

entries.key: Adds {0} Absorption {#} to potions with that stat.
entries.value: §7為具有該數值的藥水增加 {0}§6 吸收 {#}§7。

entries.key: Adds {0} Chums dropped on Sea Creatures fished with this bait.
entries.value: §7用此魚餌釣起的海怪會額外掉落 {0}§a 個魚餌碎屑§7。

entries.key: Adds {0} Level to your {enchantment}, {enchantment2}, and {enchantment3} enchantments.
entries.value: §7使你的{enchantment}§7、{enchantment2}§7與{enchantment3} §7附魔§d等級§7提升 {0}§7。
